name: Tabular Iris feature pipeline
description: Every feature ends with a mean near 0

data.noteContent:
Iris is 150 rows, four measurements and three species: the smallest table that still needs every step of a real tabular pipeline. Those steps are the graph, left to right: read the CSV, take all four columns, z-score them, then split into train and test. After a run the Print shows one mean per feature. z-scoring put every column of the whole table at zero, and the 120-row training split keeps them there, within about 0.03. A mean far from zero would say the split is not representative of the table it came from: raise test_size, or turn stratify off, and watch them move.

Iris 有 150 列、四個量測欄位、三個品種，是還用得上完整表格流程的最小資料集。那些步驟就是這張圖由左到右的順序：讀進 CSV、四個欄位全取、做 z-score，再切成訓練集與測試集。跑完之後，Print 會印出每個特徵一個平均值。z-score 把整張表的每一欄都拉到 0，120 列的訓練集也留在 0 附近，誤差大約 0.03 以內。某一欄離 0 很遠，就表示這次切分沒能代表原本那張表：把 test_size 調大，或把 stratify 關掉，看它們怎麼動。

stratify keeps all three species at the proportion they have in the table: exactly 10 of each in the 30-row test set. Turn it off and the counts drift with the seed -- which on an imbalanced dataset is how a rare class ends up with no test rows at all.

stratify 讓三個品種維持它們在原表裡的比例：30 列的測試集剛好每種 10 列。關掉之後，數量會隨著 seed 浮動 — 換成類別不平衡的資料集，稀有類別就可能一列測試資料都分不到。
